title: UPISuccessSchema
description: Schema for extracting UPI payment success screen fields

utr.description: 12-digit UPI Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) or UPI Ref No

order_id.description: Merchant order ID or transaction ID

payee_name.description: Payee name, e.g. BMRCL, Bangalore Metro Rail Corp Ltd

bank_name.description: Sender bank, e.g. HDFC, SBI, ICICI

app_name.description: UPI app: Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, etc.

status_text.description: Payment status text, e.g. 'Paid successfully', 'Payment Successful'

language_detected.description: Language of the screen: en, kn, hi
